Structural Engineering Specifications — Project Cedar Ridge:
- Foundation type: Slab-on-grade with continuous perimeter stem wall.
- Concrete mix design: Minimum compressive strength of 4000 PSI at 28-day cure, maximum water-to-cementitious ratio of 0.45. Air entrainment 4.5% to 6.0% for freeze-thaw durability.
- Reinforcing steel: ASTM A615 Grade 60 #4 deformed rebar placed in a grid at 12 inches on center (OC) each way, supported on concrete dobies 2 inches above the 15-mil vapor barrier.
- Minimum cure time prior to framing load application: 7 days moist cure with burlap, 28 days total before bearing full roof truss weight.
